titleText.es: Los verdaderos programadores establecen las constantes universales adecuadas para que el universo evolucione y acabe conteniendo el disco con los datos que quieren.
titleText.en: Real programmers set the appropriate universal constants so that the universe evolves and ends up containing the disk with the data they want.
titleText.noteEn: The title text extends the escalation by imagining programmers choosing the laws of physics so that the desired disk eventually exists on its own.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: no separate English word here; Spanish uses the article before a general group
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Spanish normally uses los before a plural group discussed as a whole, as in los programadores. English often leaves “the” out and simply says “programmers” when making the same general statement.
Mano is feminine despite ending in -o, so it takes una and feminine describing forms.
With mano, firme describes a hand that does not shake and can make precise movements.

example.es: Dibuja la línea con mano firme.
example.en: Draw the line with a steady hand.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: excuse me; forgive me (said to several familiar people)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Perdonad is the positive command used in Spain when addressing more than one familiar listener. Me attaches to it and identifies the speaker asking to be excused.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: it flaps (special form after dejan que)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Bata comes from batir. Ordinary bate states that it flaps; after dejar que, bata presents the flapping as the action being allowed. The special form is called the subjunctive.

example.es: Deja que el pájaro bata las alas.
example.en: Let the bird flap its wings.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Here una gives the number of occasions rather than introducing an unspecified thing.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: no separate English word; marks propagarse, “to spread”
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Propagarse describes something spreading or traveling outward without naming an outside agent that spreads it. Se stays before the changed form of propagar.

example.es: El sonido se propaga por el aire.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Bolsa usually means a bag. In scientific descriptions, a bolsa de aire is a bounded pocket or localized mass of air.

example.es: Hay bolsas de aire frío en el valle.
example.en: There are pockets of cold air in the valley.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Spanish can use a before a measured or described physical condition, as in a alta presión or a baja temperatura.

example.es: El gas está a alta presión.
example.en: The gas is at high pressure.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Enfocando is the ongoing-action form of enfocar, “to focus.” Los attaches to the end and means “them,” referring to masculine plural things.

example.es: Ajusta los rayos enfocándolos en un punto.
example.en: Adjust the rays by focusing them on one point.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: they hit; strike (special purpose form after para que)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Incidan comes from incidir. Ordinary inciden states that several things strike a surface; after para que, incidan presents that impact as the intended result. The special form is called the subjunctive.

example.es: Mueve el espejo para que los rayos incidan aquí.
example.en: Move the mirror so that the rays hit here.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: platter (the magnetic disk inside a drive)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Plato normally means a plate or dish. In computer hardware, a plato is one of the flat circular surfaces on which a hard drive stores data.

example.es: El disco tiene dos platos magnéticos.
example.en: The disk has two magnetic platters.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: In computing, unidad can mean a storage drive, as in unidad de disco. This is different from the general meaning “unit.”

example.es: La unidad guarda una copia del archivo.
example.en: The drive stores a copy of the file.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: they change; flip (a bit, special purpose form)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Ordinary cambian states that several things change something. Cambien is the special form used here because it remains inside the intended result introduced by para que.

example.es: Ajusta el sistema para que cambien el valor.
example.en: Adjust the system so that they change the value.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: A bit is the smallest ordinary unit of digital information and has one of two values, conventionally 0 or 1.

example.es: Ese bit cambia de cero a uno.
example.en: That bit changes from zero to one.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Used by itself as a reaction, bonito can approve something as pleasing or impressive rather than describe a specific masculine noun.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: command (an instruction given to a computer)

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Before the name of a familiar thing, viejo can express affectionate or nostalgic familiarity. It need not literally claim that the thing is physically old.

example.es: Volvamos al viejo método de siempre.
example.en: Let us return to the good old usual method.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: no separate English word here; article before the name of a command
cardDefinitions.noteEn: A masculine noun such as comando can remain understood before its specific name, while el still appears. Natural English often gives the command name directly without “the.”

cardDefinitions.promptEs: nano, Emacs, Vim, ed y cat
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Unix editing tools arranged as a one-upmanship joke about using increasingly bare-bones methods
cardDefinitions.noteEn: nano, Emacs, Vim, and ed are text editors with very different interfaces. cat normally displays or joins file contents, though shell redirection can use typed input to create a file. Each speaker claims that a less comfortable, lower-level tool is what a “real” programmer would use, until the methods become physically absurd.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: the idea that a very small change can lead to much larger later differences in a chaotic system
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The phrase is associated with weather and chaos theory. The comic literalizes it by treating one butterfly wingbeat as a disturbance that can be controlled precisely through the atmosphere.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: cambio de bit por un rayo cósmico
cardDefinitions.answerEn: energetic radiation can disturb electronics and accidentally change a stored bit
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Cosmic rays can contribute to rare hardware errors called bit flips. The absurd step in the comic is focusing one through the atmosphere so that it strikes a chosen drive platter and changes exactly the desired bit.

excludedUnits.rationale: nano is the proper name of a text editor, not Spanish vocabulary in this question.
emacs is the proper name of a text editor, retained unchanged rather than used as Spanish vocabulary.

applications.exampleEs: DEJAN QUE BATA SUS DELICADAS ALAS
applications.explanationEn: Dejan changes for the plural people granting permission, que opens the allowed action, ordinary bate changes to the requested-action form bata, and sus delicadas alas supplies what the butterfly flaps.

regions.labelEs: LA PERTURBACIÓN SE PROPAGA, ALTERANDO EL FLUJO DE LAS CORRIENTES ARREMOLINADAS DE LA ATMÓSFERA SUPERIOR.
regions.geometryRationale: The first OCR line fused this left-hand narration with a separate sentence printed over the adjacent panel; this measured box isolates only the atmospheric-disturbance text.

QUE ACTÚAN COMO LENTES QUE DESVÍAN LOS RAYOS CÓSMICOS, ENFOCÁNDOLOS PARA QUE INCIDAN EN EL PLATO DE LA UNIDAD Y CAMBIEN EL BIT DESEADO.
regions.geometryRationale: The first OCR line fused this right-hand narration with the separate atmospheric sentence over the adjacent panel; this measured box isolates only the cosmic-ray text.

applications.exampleEs: PARA QUE INCIDAN EN EL PLATO DE LA UNIDAD Y CAMBIEN EL BIT DESEADO
applications.explanationEn: Para que introduces the intended result; incidan and cambien are the two coordinated special purpose forms, and the intervening words supply the places and things involved in those intended actions.

regions.labelEs: BONITO. POR SUPUESTO, EMACS TIENE UN COMANDO PARA HACER ESO.

excludedUnits.rationale: EMACS is the proper name of a text editor, not a Spanish lexical word.

applications.explanationEn: Por and supuesto stay together as the fixed expression that confidently treats the next point as expected.
Para introduces the purpose, and hacer remains in its unchanged -er dictionary form.

excludedUnits.rationale: This is a fictional Emacs keyboard-command sequence composed of key notation and an English command name, not Spanish vocabulary.
EMACS is the proper name of the text editor being cursed, not Spanish vocabulary.
